The Ace Cocktail
By: 12 Bottle Bar
Published: Monday, September 27, 2010 - 1:05pm

Ingredients




1 1/2 ounces Dry Gin
1/2 ounce Grenadine
1/2 ounce Cream
1/4 teaspoon Lemon Juice
White of Egg

Preparation

1 Combine all ingredients in a mixing glass without ice. Shake. 2 Add ice. Shake again. 3 Strain into a coupe. 4 Grate Fresh Nutmeg over the top.

About


The Ace is a funny little drink, and one of the most obscure ones we've done to date.  Whenever you see a drink recipe calling for cream and nutmeg, you know it's meant primarily for one thing: brunch.  And boy, what a brunch drink it is.
